title: RTF (Rich Text Format) signature
summary: An RTF document begins with the 5-byte signature {\rtf followed by a version number (e.g. {\rtf1).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Immediately followed by a version number: {\rtf1 (version 1, the only version).
RTF is a 7-bit ASCII format with backslash-escaped control words and curly-brace groups.
